A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same KG-ViP research work. All 14 pages of each version, including equations, tables, figures and Appendices A.1–A.4, are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations and architecture comparisons in Tables 1–5, an encoder comparison in Figure 3, and qualitative examples in Appendix A.3.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark scores, component analyses and appendix case studies.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same graph construction, two-stage retrieval, pruning, fusion and optional refinement procedures. The existing method prompts in Appendix A.4 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate FVQA 2.0+ for fact-based VQA and MVQA for movie-based multi-hop reasoning. The represented data, domains and task requirements are unchanged.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Zero-shot, CoT, Fine-Tuning, CCoT, NaiveRAG, FilterRAG and LLM-RA. Comparator membership also remains unchanged in the architecture comparisons and appendix case studies.

E3.justification: Dataset sizes, model configurations, baseline settings, metrics and judge models are unchanged in Section 4 and Appendix A.1. The newly supplied judging prompt documents an existing evaluation procedure; neither version establishes a protocol revision.

E4.justification: The fusion/refinement, retrieval-mode, pruning, encoder-selection and architecture-robustness analyses are unchanged in Tables 2–5 and Figure 3. Figure 4 retains the same three qualitative cases.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. The new judging rubric does not introduce statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: The result entries in Tables 1–5 and Figures 3–4 are unchanged. For example, KG-ViP's DeepSeek-judged LLM-J scores remain 60.40 on FVQA 2.0+ and 35.44 on MVQA.

T1.justification: The MMKG definitions, subgraph constructions and fusion-similarity equation in Section 3 are unchanged. No formal assumption, theorem, proof or mathematical derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions: integrating complementary scene and commonsense graphs through KG-ViP and demonstrating superior VQA performance. Their scientific scope and strength are unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations of graph fusion, visual retrieval and encoder performance are retained. Both versions state the same limitations concerning scene-graph parsing quality and updating the offline commonsense graph.

D1.justification: Appendix A.4 adds an explicit LLM-as-a-Judge prompt with reference/prediction inputs, a single-score output requirement and graded correctness criteria from 0 to 1. This supplies reproducibility information absent from v1; the other implementation and access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The reference list and substantive positioning relative to prior VQA, retrieval and scene-graph research are unchanged. The new unresolved citation marker in the introduction identifies no additional work and is a presentation defect.

P1.justification: v2 updates affiliations and contact details, adds equal-contribution/corresponding-author notes and funding acknowledgements, and places the retained QA-generation paragraph under A.3 Case Study. It also introduces an unresolved citation marker; the scientific prose otherwise remains unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 moves from page 8 to page 7, Table 6 changes column placement, and Figure 4 shifts earlier on page 13. A new boxed judging prompt changes the appendix layout, while existing figures, table structures and captions remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The explicit judging prompt and scoring rubric in Appendix A.4 improve reproducibility of a central evaluation metric beyond v1's generic description. This limited gain outweighs the small editorial regressions from the unresolved citation and misplaced QA-generation paragraph. The scientific methods and evidence remain unchanged.
